constants.name: n_objects
constants.why: size of the object space: 4 attributes x 4 values (N_ATTR, N_VAL in method/run.py)

constants.name: holdout_frac
constants.why: fraction of attribute combinations held out for testing (HOLDOUT_FRAC in method/run.py)

constants.name: train_frac
constants.why: fraction of attribute combinations used for training (1 - HOLDOUT_FRAC in method/run.py)

constants.name: learning_rate
constants.why: Adam learning rate, default of --lr in method/run.py, used by every run

constants.name: batch_size
constants.why: training batch size, default of --batch in method/run.py, used by every run

constants.name: baseline_decay
constants.why: decay of the REINFORCE running-mean reward baseline in method/run.py

constants.name: baseline_update
constants.why: weight of the new batch reward in the REINFORCE running-mean baseline in method/run.py

constants.name: entropy_weight
constants.why: REINFORCE sender entropy bonus beta, default of --ent in method/run.py

constants.name: curve_log_interval
constants.why: steps between train-accuracy curve points when --curve is given (method/run.py)
